links.comparator_used: Original online alveolar bone grafting patient education materials (unsimplified)
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of ABG patient education materials
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level improved from 8.0 ± 2.3 (original) to 6.1 ± 1.3 after ChatGPT rewriting (p < 0.0001); original was significantly above AMA recommended sixth grade level (p < 0.0001)
links.quote: PEM rewriting with ChatGPT improved Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level to 6.1 ± 1.3 (p < 0.0001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint via LLM rewriting of patient education materials
